description:
A malicious version of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension distributed through the Cursor marketplace attempted to install a persistent Secure Shell (SSH) backdoor on developers’ machines, potentially giving attackers remote access to systems holding source code, credentials and other sensitive information.

“Between about 2:27am PT and 1:35pm PT today, a maliciously modified version of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension was made available in the Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace,” Cursor said in a security notice.</
title: Cursor removes malicious Claude Code extension after SSH backdoor attempt

description:

description:
The modern web is a miracle of engineering, but its history is littered with brilliant concepts that flamed out in execution.
